content.query:
select MCC_CODE MCC_CODE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT MCC_CODE MCC_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_MERCHANTCODE WHERE MCC_CODE='3115'
UNION ALL
SELECT MCC_CODE MCC_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_MERCHANTCODE WHERE MCC_CODE='7251'
UNION ALL
SELECT MCC_CODE MCC_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_MERCHANTCODE WHERE MCC_CODE='8042'
UNION ALL
SELECT MCC_CODE MCC_CODE2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_MERCHANTCODE WHERE MCC_CODE='999999' ) temp order by MCC_CODE, SCD_START_DATE
